title: TLCTC Operational Enumeration (Sub-Clusters) — Schema
description: Validates the evolving TLCTC-XX.YY sub-cluster catalogue (operational layer). Companion to the Layer-1 framework dictionary, kept separate so it can evolve without re-minting the frozen strategic core. Sub-cluster IDs validate against the same TLCTC-XX.YY shape used by Layer-3 and Layer-4 cluster references.

sub_clusters.description: Flat list of operational sub-clusters and refinements across all ten strategic clusters.

id.description: Operational ID. TLCTC-XX.Y0 = sub-cluster (vector class); TLCTC-XX.YZ (Z≠0) = refinement. XX.00 is reserved for the top-level cluster and MUST NOT appear here.

parent_cluster.description: The strategic cluster this sub-cluster refines. Per R-SUBCLUSTER it MUST reach the same generic vulnerability as the parent.

status.description: reference = published in the core as a method demonstration; proposed = candidate awaiting review/validation; open = placeholder, no decomposition yet.
